source: Pain Machine — GitHub Issues intake (1000 issues, 17 May 2026)
description: Open index of detected operational friction patterns. Each entry represents a verified repeatable failure cluster extracted from public sources.

docker_ufw_iptables_conflict.problem: Docker bypasses UFW iptables rules — published ports remain open despite ufw deny rules

alternative_approaches.name: Manual iptables DOCKER-USER rules
alternative_approaches.note: Not persistent across reboots without script

api_gateway_timeout_ignored.problem: TrustGraph API gateway --timeout flag silently ignored, dispatchers use hardcoded 120s timeout
api_gateway_timeout_ignored.notes: Flag accepted but not propagated to DispatcherManager. Every service dispatcher hardcodes timeout=120.

schema.OES_v2: Operational Economic Score v2 — higher is better (0-1)
schema.friction: Measured operational friction from issue text (0-1)
schema.reproduction_rate: Fraction of commenters who could reproduce the issue
schema.workflow_specificity: How precisely the affected workflow is described (0-1)
schema.payment_surface: Probability that affected user would pay for a solution (0-1)
schema.primitive: Name of the tool/capability that solves this
